color.note: Garage violet comes from the app icon (#8d77f0 to #7056dc). Two editions share one token set: Garage (violet-tinted neutrals) and Garage Enterprise (deeper plum-indigo brand on cool slate neutrals). Switch with data-theme.

tokens.name: violet-050
tokens.usage: Lightest brand wash: selected rows, hover fills, focus halos.

tokens.name: violet-100
tokens.usage: The icon's glyph lavender. Subtle accent backgrounds: info callouts, accent badges, the selected card.

tokens.name: violet-300
tokens.usage: Accent borders: info callouts, the selected card's outline, accent badge borders.

tokens.name: violet-400
tokens.usage: The icon's highlight. Decorative fills only (cover, illustration, charts); never text on light grounds.

tokens.name: violet-500
tokens.usage: THE brand colour, the icon's body. Primary button fill, active nav, focus ring, links in dark themes.

tokens.name: violet-700
tokens.usage: Accent text and links on `surface` / `surface-raised`; primary button hover in light themes.

tokens.name: violet-900
tokens.usage: Deepest brand ink: headings set in brand, text on `violet-100`.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background (`--bg-primary` on the site); window content in the app.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Header, footer, table stripes, details summaries, secondary buttons (`--bg-secondary`).

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Pressed secondary buttons, code-block wells, tertiary panels (`--bg-tertiary`).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text and headings on `surface`, `surface-raised` and `surface-sunken`.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: card blurbs, nav links, captions, on `surface` and `surface-raised`.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Placeholders, meta lines, the search icon. Large or non-essential text only on `surface`.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Card, input, table and panel borders (`--border`).

tokens.name: line-subtle
tokens.usage: Hairlines: header rule under h1/h2, dividers inside panels.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders that must meet 3:1: inputs, checkboxes, secondary-button hover.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `violet-500` (primary button label).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success text and icons: 'ok', 'landed', 'Added'. Always with a word or icon.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Success callout and badge background.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning text and icons: 'deferred', alpha notices.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Warning callout and badge background.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors, destructive actions (Reset Database), failed ingest. Always with a word or icon.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Danger callout and badge background.

tokens.name: corpus-document
tokens.usage: Badge and dot for `corpus_class = document`.

tokens.name: corpus-code
tokens.usage: Badge and dot for `corpus_class = code` (the brand violet).

tokens.name: corpus-communication
tokens.usage: Badge and dot for `corpus_class = communication`, which never leaves the machine.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset, on every interactive control.

families.sans: "IBM Plex Sans", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Noto Sans", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace

styles.name: display
styles.sample: Your files, searchable by your assistants
styles.usage: Landing hero title (2.8rem). One per page.

styles.name: title-1
styles.sample: How Garage keeps your data local
styles.usage: Page title (prose h1, 2.1rem) with a `line-subtle` rule under it.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase kicker above a title, in `violet-700`.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Garage indexes your documents, code and mail on your computer and nowhere else.

styles.name: term
styles.sample: Corpus — everything Garage has indexed from your sources.
styles.usage: Term tooltip body, in `ink-muted`, with the term's name above it at 600 in `ink`.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Inline code and code blocks (0.88rem) on `surface-raised`.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap inside badges; tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Button icon gap, badge padding, list item spacing.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between related controls; header padding block.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Callout padding, code-block padding, default gap; the phone gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card grid gap, nav gap, detail padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding, page side padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Grid margin, profile gap.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Hero padding, section spacing, page top padding.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Inline code.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, small logo tiles, callout corners.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, inputs, code blocks, details.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Hero, download and feature panels.

tokens.name: radius-icon
tokens.usage: The app icon at 80px (macOS squircle approximation); scale ~27% of the side.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status badges, availability chips.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Resting cards and screenshot details.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: Hovered cards (with a 2px rise and a `violet-500` border).

tokens.name: shadow-icon
tokens.usage: The app icon in a hero.
